title: The Haunted Queue — Refactor an Async Scheduler

checks.name: deterministic demonstration
checks.details: The mixed-priority demonstration completed without unresolved jobs.

summary: Replaced the tangled legacy JobQueue with a typed state machine that preserves the public surface, enforces unique live IDs, FIFO-within-priority, correct retry backoff, AbortError cancellation (including backoff timers), and drain that waits for pending, running, and retry-waiting work.
